title: 重排水果
summary: 两个篮子可交换任意一对水果，交换成本为两水果较小值；求使两篮子多重集合相同的最小成本，不可能返回负一。
insight: 合并频次为奇数的水果无法均分。对每个值取两篮子频次差的一半形成各自多余列表，第一列表升序、第二列表降序配对。每对可直接交换，或借全局最小水果做两次中转，成本取 min(min(a,b),2*globalMin)。
pitfalls: 总频次为奇数立即无解
差额只需取一半加入交换列表
相反顺序配对使直接交换成本最小
全局最小值可能来自任一篮子

solutions.title: 配对多余水果与最小值中转
solutions.idea: 先平衡多重集合差额，再逐对选择更便宜交换方式。
steps: 统计 basket1-basket2 的 frequencyDifference，并求 globalMinimum
任一 difference 为奇数返回 -1
difference>0 时加入 firstExtras difference/2 次，<0 加入 secondExtras -difference/2 次

code.java: class Solution { public long minCost(int[] basket1,int[] basket2){Map<Integer,Integer> difference=new HashMap<>();int minimum=Integer.MAX_VALUE;for(int value:basket1){difference.merge(value,1,Integer::sum);minimum=Math.min(minimum,value);}for(int value:basket2){difference.merge(value,-1,Integer::sum);minimum=Math.min(minimum,value);}List<Integer> first=new ArrayList<>(),second=new ArrayList<>();for(Map.Entry<Integer,Integer> entry:difference.entrySet()){int count=entry.getValue();if(Math.abs(count)%2==1)return -1;for(int i=0;i<count/2;i++)first.add(entry.getKey());for(int i=0;i<-count/2;i++)second.add(entry.getKey());}Collections.sort(first);second.sort(Comparator.reverseOrder());long cost=0;for(int i=0;i<first.size();i++)cost+=Math.min(Math.min(first.get(i),second.get(i)),2L*minimum);return cost;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun minCost(basket1:IntArray,basket2:IntArray):Long{val difference=HashMap<Int,Int>();var minimum=Int.MAX_VALUE;for(value in basket1){difference[value]=(difference[value]?:0)+1;minimum=minOf(minimum,value)};for(value in basket2){difference[value]=(difference[value]?:0)-1;minimum=minOf(minimum,value)};val first=mutableListOf<Int>();val second=mutableListOf<Int>();for((value,count) in difference){if(kotlin.math.abs(count)%2==1)return -1;repeat(maxOf(0,count/2)){first.add(value)};repeat(maxOf(0,-count/2)){second.add(value)}};first.sort();second.sortDescending();var cost=0L;for(i in first.indices)cost+=minOf(first[i].toLong(),second[i].toLong(),2L*minimum);return cost} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:long long minCost(vector<int>& basket1,vector<int>& basket2){unordered_map<int,int> difference;int minimum=INT_MAX;for(int value:basket1){++difference[value];minimum=min(minimum,value);}for(int value:basket2){--difference[value];minimum=min(minimum,value);}vector<int> first,second;for(auto [value,count]:difference){if(abs(count)%2)return -1;for(int i=0;i<count/2;++i)first.push_back(value);for(int i=0;i<-count/2;++i)second.push_back(value);}sort(first.begin(),first.end());sort(second.rbegin(),second.rend());long long cost=0;for(int i=0;i<(int)first.size();++i)cost+=min({1LL*first[i],1LL*second[i],2LL*minimum});return cost;} };
